name: roblox
description: Roblox: sign in as an account with its cookie, join a place, keep sign-ins with `login`

args.help: sign in as this account: a file holding its .ROBLOSECURITY cookie, a name `login` saved (<app-data>/../cookies/<name>.txt), or the value itself; play keeps storage per account (<app-data>/../accounts/<name>)
join this place once the sign-in reaches Home

login.help: [<username> [<password>]] [--dir <dir>]: sign in to Roblox in Chromium and keep the cookie, username and password in <dir> (default <app-data>/../cookies)
